professionalSummary: Project manager with over three years of experience leading store refits at Brackley Home & Garden, managing integrated schedules, budgets, contractor relations and store trading coordination to minimise customer disruption.
experienceHighlights: Built and maintained integrated refit schedules for stores ranging from 30,000 to 60,000 sq ft using the planning tool, linking strip‑out, mechanical, electrical, fixture installation and stock replenishment.
Tracked refit budgets against approved capital spend, reporting monthly variances and change‑order commentary to the property director.
Coordinated overnight and weekend working windows with store managers, issuing weekly works notices to keep customer areas open during works.
Attended weekly progress meetings with main contractors, documenting actions and logging variation requests for commercial review.
projectsAndWorkSamples: An anonymised 11‑week refit schedule for a single store, illustrating the critical path through mechanical and electrical works and the stock replenishment plan for reopening.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample establish the candidate’s experience in integrated scheduling, budget control, contractor management, store trading coordination and possession of a recognised PRINCE2 Practitioner certification. No evidence is provided regarding dispute resolution beyond logging variation requests or experience with a portfolio of 40 store refits.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review required to assess fit based on evidence and gaps.

evidence.text: Built the integrated refit schedules in the planning tool, linking strip‑out, mechanical and electrical works, fixture installation and stock replenishment.
Attended weekly progress meetings with the main contractors, kept the meeting actions list and logged their variation requests for the commercial manager to assess.
evidence.notes: Shows contractor management and variation logging

evidence.text: Tracked each refit budget against the approved capital spend and reported monthly variances to the property director, with commentary on change orders.

Agreed overnight and weekend working windows with store managers so that customer areas stayed open during the works, and issued a weekly works notice to each store listing the areas closed and the hoarding positions.
The candidate's PRINCE2 Practitioner certificate was checked on the accrediting body's successful‑candidate register; it is listed as current, with the examination recorded in May 2022.
